title: Streamlining of MediFund Application Process to Allow Approval to be Accepted Across Healthcare Institutions
what_it_is: Streamlining of MediFund Application Process to Allow Approval to be Accepted Across Healthcare Institutions

sections.label: MediFund approvals devolved to institutions
sections.summary: MOH has devolved MediFund approvals to the MediFund Committees of individual healthcare institutions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) has devolved MediFund approvals to the MediFund Committees of individual healthcare institutions.

sections.label: MediFund application process changes
sections.summary: MOH reviewed the MediFund application process and will implement mutual recognition arrangements for transfers to step-down care and within-cluster outpatient treatment by March 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: In line with that, MOH has reviewed the MediFund application process to make it more seamless with limited impact on the flexibility and discretion of the MediFund Committees.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: And we will be implementing the following changes by March 2024.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: First, a mutual recognition arrangement between acute hospital and step-down care.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: This means that when a patient benefiting from MediFund is transferred from an acute hospital to step-down care, he or she will continue to benefit from MediFund without having to re-apply again.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: As the medical bills, social and financial circumstances of patients may vary over time as they transfer from one institution to another, this automatic extension of MediFund will be for three months or until the receiving institution reassesses the patient’s eligibility for continued MediFund assistance.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: The second change is a mutual recognition arrangement within the same healthcare cluster for outpatient treatment.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: For example, if a patient is receiving MediFund at an outpatient institution, say, a polyclinic, and he goes to another MediFund institution within the same healthcare cluster, say, a specialist at a Specialised Outpatient Clinic, he will automatically receive support from MediFund and does not need to re-apply for his outpatient bills another time.

sections.label: MediFund support after ComCare graduation
sections.summary: MediFund support will continue for three months after graduation from ComCare to strengthen support for ComCare graduates.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: So, there is a bit of a cliff effect.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Health (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: So, to strengthen support for these ComCare graduates on their journey to self-reliance, MediFund support will continue for three months after graduation from ComCare.
